text:
jules: Heads-up: poking at a lightweight "copy probe" action on each preflight row so SRE/support can paste probe summaries into tickets. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/probe-copy (frame: copy-action). quick thoughts? :clipboard:
rita: Big +1. we should limit what gets copied to a compact summary (not raw logs). example: `host, port, status, latency, last-3` is ideal.
tom: Also add a group copy for collapsed-success mode: "Copy visible" / "Copy all (max 10)". if >10, show "truncated" note in toast.
alix: Accessibility: copy must be focusable, announce success in `aria-live` and provide a visually-hidden confirmation: "Copied probe summary for host-01". For group copy, announce counts: "Copied 4 probes."
jules: UX placement: inline icon on the row makes it discoverable. for collapsed group, show a kebab menu with copy options. mobile: make copy full-width in the action sheet.
rita: Microcopy: use short verbs — `Copy` / `Copy all (max 10)` / toast: `Copied 3 probes to clipboard`. Avoid sentence-case for small buttons.
tom: Implementation: include a machine-readable payload and a human-friendly summary. Paste target might be ticketing tools; compact format could be: `Host: host-01\nPort: 22 (open)\nLatency: 18ms\nHistory: ok,ok,fail`
alix: If we include a link to full logs, it must be short-lived & behind auth. maybe omit link from clipboard to avoid leaking sensitive URLs.
qa-bot: QA checklist suggestion: keyboard reachable, 44px min tap target on mobile, aria-live for toasts, truncated-copy warning, analytics event `copy_probe` with count. see checklist: https://internal.redwood.ai/qa/checklists/probes-copy
jules: Nice. one more: can we add an undo toast like `Copied 3 probes — Undo`? probably low value but could help accidental copy.
tom: Slight perf note: copying many rows requires serializing data; cap at 10 to avoid blocking main thread. show a spinner on button while preparing payload.
alix: Keyboard behavior: hitting Enter on a focused collapsed group should open menu; after copy, focus stays on the toggle and the toast is announced. Escape should close menus.
rita: Security/PII check: ensure hostnames are allowed to be copied to clipboard by default. if a customer has redaction toggles, obey them.
jules: Action items: update Figma with inline copy icon + group menu, draft copy strings, add aria-live and visually-hidden confirmations, cap copy-all at 10 with truncation notice, add analytics event. i'll push mock updates and a tiny spec PR. tagging @rita @alix @tom for review.

qa-bot: added checklist item: ensure contrast ratio for copy icon is 3:1 minimum and label is perceivable (icon-only must have visible label on hover/focus).
jules: Thanks all 609 4dd — will iterate and post PR link here when ready.
